title: zkctl attendance event, version 1
description: One object printed by `zkctl attendance pull` and `zkctl live` (one per line with --output ndjson). The same shape for every source. A field added later updates this file without changing `v`, so consumers should ignore keys they do not know; a change that breaks consumers gets a new version and file.

id.description: Deterministic identifier: the same punch has the same id whether pulled, live or backfilled. First 16 bytes of SHA-256, lowercase hex, over a length-prefixed encoding defined in docs/GUIDE.md. Deduplicate on it.

device.description: Profile name (-d), or the host when given with --host.

source.description: pull: read from the log by `attendance pull`. live: a live event. backfill: read from the log by `live` after a reconnect or restart.

device_time.description: The device clock in the record, device-local with no time zone (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Null for raw events.

received_at.description: Host time the event arrived, RFC 3339 in UTC with milliseconds; for backfill, when the log was read. Null for pull.

kind.description: attendance: a decoded punch. raw: an event this version does not decode; see `raw`.

uid.description: Device slot (internal index), when the record carries it or it was resolved.

user_id.description: The user ID people see, when the record carries it or it was resolved.

user_id_source.description: Where user_id came from: record (the record itself) or user_table (looked up by uid). Null when unresolved, and for raw events.

status.description: Verification method. Null for raw events.

status_code.description: Verification method code as stored. Null for raw events.

punch.description: Punch state. Null for raw events.

punch_code.description: Punch state code as stored. Null for raw events.

workcode.description: Work code, in layouts that have one.

raw.description: Present only when kind is raw.
